edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 7

source_text: Sub Moyse non est dictum quod sub Iesu: Cessavit terra a proeliis — solius Iesu virtute terra nostra cessare poterit. Intra nos Chananaei et Pherezaei; meditemur in lege die ac nocte. Exsurge qui dormis et exsurge a mortuis. Iam te a Moyse suscepit Iesus, qui te secundo circumcidat in colle praeputiorum — non solum idolorum cultus sed avaritia, quae est idolorum subtilior cultus. Hodie abstuli a vobis opprobrium Aegypti. Si secundam circumcisionem acceperis vitiorum, Aegypti abstergentur opprobria et hereditatem regni caelestis accipies per verum Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum, cui est gloria in saecula saeculorum. Amen.

Within us Canaanites and Perizzites; let-us-meditate in law day and night. Arise who sleep and arise from dead. Already you from Moses has-taken Jesus, who you a-second-time may-circumcise on hill of-foreskins — not only of-idols worship but greed, which is of-idols subtler worship. Today I-removed from you reproach of-Egypt. If second circumcision you-shall-have-received of-vices, of-Egypt will-be-wiped reproaches and inheritance of-kingdom heavenly you-will-receive through true Jesus Christ Lord our, to-whom is glory into ages of-ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Under Moses it was not said what is said under Jesus: [[The land rested from wars >> Bible:Joshua 11:23]]. Only by the Lord Jesus’ power can our land — where we struggle — cease from battles. Within us are Canaanites and Perizzites; therefore [[meditate on the Lord’s law day and night >> Bible:Psalm 1:2]]. Many of you sleep not only by night but all day in worldly business or fleshly delights, and scarcely come to church on feast days — some who come attend to stories, not God’s word. [[Awake, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you >> Bible:Ephesians 5:14]]. You have fasted? It is as if you left Egypt and followed Moses; but now Jesus has taken you from Moses and [[circumcises you a second time at the hill of foreskins >> Bible:Joshua 5:2-3]] — not only casting off idol-worship but also greed, a subtler idolatry. [[Today I have rolled away from you the reproach of Egypt >> Bible:Joshua 5:9]]. If you receive this second circumcision of the vices, Egypt’s reproaches are wiped away and you inherit the heavenly kingdom through the true Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory forever. Amen >> Bible:Galatians 1:5]].
